findings.documented: Append API key as a query parameter: ?api_key=...
findings.actual: API key must be sent in the X-API-Key request header.
findings.how_found: Got a 401 Unauthorized with detail: 'send your key in the X-API-Key request header, not as a query parameter'.

findings.actual: Returns access_token, refresh_token, and expires_in is 900 (15 minutes).
findings.how_found: The login response JSON didn't contain 'token' and failed the initial auth script.

findings.actual: Pagination uses offset instead of page and the API strictly enforces a maximum limit of 50.
findings.how_found: The limit=100 parameter resulted in only 50 records being returned per request.

findings.documented: Returns active sale listings... Inactive, expired and withdrawn listings are excluded server side
findings.actual: The endpoint returns listings where is_live: false.
findings.how_found: Found 708 listings with is_live set to false.

findings.documented: Money: Indian rupees, integer, everywhere in the API
findings.actual: price_min and price_max are floats representing Crores, not integer Rupees.
The /v1/favourites endpoint (and /v1/favorites) returns 404 Not Found and does not seem to exist.
findings.how_found: When implementing the Saved feature, calls to these endpoints returned 404.

findings.actual: The endpoint is actually implemented as plural: /v1/listings/{id}. Using the documented singular /v1/listing/{id} returns a 404.
findings.how_found: When clicking a listing detail in the frontend, fetch('/v1/listing/...') returned a 404 Not Found error. Changing it to plural fixed it.

findings.documented: Every listing_id is globally unique, and each listing corresponds to exactly one physical property.
findings.actual: Listings contain duplicates. Multiple listing_ids refer to the exact same physical property.
findings.how_found: Analysis of the data revealed multiple listing records describing the identical physical property.

findings.actual: Certain listings have physically impossible values (e.g., floor > total_floors).
findings.how_found: Compared floor vs total_floors across all listings and found 6 violations.

findings.actual: Several listings are fake or fraudulently submitted.
findings.how_found: Detected 6 fake listing_ids during deep analysis.
